system.description:
[Trigger: Setup] Select one Sq within 2Sq from you. Place the prop 【Mind Floor】 on the target Sq with PR9. The prop's tag is [Magic]. This effect lasts until the end of the round. A throwing weapon made from metal that has been continuously exposed to the glow of the moon reflected in a spirit spring. Not only is it a powerful weapon, but it can also unleash the magic power of the moon's reflection on water, creating an illusionary barrier that confuses enemies.

Moonlight Golden Scale [Core Material] (140G) + Eight-Pointed Shuriken (230G) ×2 + Firefly Gem (40G) ×4 + [Magic Catalyst 9] (90G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (370G)
